$description: Leaf Digital brand tokens. v1 values were mined from archive-site-v1-static/index.html (the live v1 site); the `v3` block below supersedes them wherever the two disagree and is what src/app/globals.css actually ships. Canonical source for the Tailwind v4 theme.

logo.note: The mark + wordmark green (favicon.svg, nav logo). Deep forest. Used ONLY for the logo on v1; proposed as brand-900-adjacent anchor.

green.note: 50-200 are Tailwind-green tints (backgrounds/badges); 400-900 are the Material-green ramp. v1 CTA gradient: 135deg green-500 → green-700. Text-on-white uses green-700+ (green-500 fails 4.5:1 contrast on white — body-text use is banned).

neutral.note: Tailwind gray scale, verbatim from v1. Body text gray-800 on white; secondary gray-500.

family.proposed: Geist Sans via next/font — cleaner, self-hostable, zero external request; Poppins kept as the continuity option if the maintainer prefers exact v1 look

v3.$description: The v3 visual direction (finalised in design mockups). Brand greens are unchanged; neutrals, radius and type are not.

ink.note: Body text and headings. Green-tinted near-black — replaces neutral-800.

ink-faint.note: Captions, fine print, meta lines — never a link. Darkened from the v3 handoff's #8B948D (3.13:1 on white, fails AA on every line of fine print on the site) along the same hue to clear 4.5:1 on both white and surface-muted. See BRAND.md.

hairline.note: Alpha ink lines: soft / default / strong. Never a gray hex.

surface.note: Full-bleed dark statement band. Max 1-2 per page. Corrected from #0B120D to match the v3 reference HTML.

surface-deep.note: A shade heavier than the band: the footer's ground, and the first stop of the final-CTA gradient.

brand-on-dark.note: The kicker on the dark band — the ONE place a below-800 green carries text.

typography.family: Geist Sans (prose) + Geist Mono (all numbers and data, with tabular-nums), both via next/font

section-h2.note: Spec range 44-48px; the token ships the 44px floor.

shape.note: A fixed ladder, not a calc off one seed. Capped at 18px — no rounded-2xl+ containers.
shape.shadow-cta: 0 4px 15px rgba(76,175,80,0.35) — key CTAs only, unchanged from v1
